mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals reduced supply chain pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive GDP growth (GDPC1) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during positive GDP growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5%) signals tightening monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment claims (implied by PAYEMS decline) signals labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines sharply, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of post-shock recovery instances when RSAFS > 3mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
